g_belly_1.text: My belly's getting bigger. My plan is working.

g_caught_5.text: That was the sports section. Rude.
g_caught_5.gen_text: That was the sports section. Rude.

g_caught_6.text: Flattened by the evening news. Classic.

g_caught_7.text: I'll be fine. I'm well padded.

g_caught_8.text: Round one to the human. The war continues.

g_chased_2.text: Cats don't run. We relocate. Quickly.

g_chased_3.text: I regret nothing! Except the running.

g_chased_7.text: This is the most exercise I've done all year.

g_chased_8.text: Run now, nap later. Run now, nap later.

g_chased_9.text: Why does he always take things so personally?

g_curtain_1.text: Rrrrip. Ah, the sweet sound of interior decorating.

g_door_1.text: And... close. Enjoy your room, Jon.

g_eat_2.text: Mmm-hmm! Oh yes. Oh, that's the stuff.

g_eat_3.text: Gulp! Gone. Like it was never there.

g_escape_4.text: Safe. The high ground always wins.

g_escape_5.text: Phew. Now I need a nap. And a snack. And another nap.

g_fridge_top.text: Up here, I'm the king of the kitchen.

g_gaveup_4.text: He'll forget about this in five minutes. He forgets where his keys are.

g_guarded_1.text: He's watching. I need a distraction.

g_guarded_2.text: Not while he's looking. Too risky.

g_guarded_3.text: First, a little chaos. Then dinner.

g_idle_01.text: I'm not lazy. I'm in energy-saving mode.
g_idle_01.gen_text: I'm not lazy. I'm in energy-saving mode.

g_idle_02.text: If I sit still long enough, maybe dinner comes to me.

g_idle_03.text: Is it nap time? It feels like nap time.

g_idle_04.text: I could do something. Or… not.

g_idle_05.text: My tummy is talking. It says 'more'.

g_idle_06.text: I need a snack, to give me strength to find a snack.

g_idle_07.text: A diet is just a sad word for 'less food'.

g_idle_08.text: Exercise? I thought you said extra pies.

g_idle_09.text: I'll get up in five minutes. Or fifty.

g_idle_10.text: Time is just the gap between meals.

g_idle_11.text: I'm not fat. I'm fluffy with ambition.

g_idle_12.text: This floor is comfy. I live here now.

g_idle_13.text: Somebody should do something. Not me, though.

g_idle_15.text: Yawn. Being this adorable is exhausting.

g_idle_16.text: Jon's dinner won't eat itself. That's my job.

g_idle_16_nn.text: His dinner won't eat itself. That's my job.

g_idle_17.text: A cat's gotta do what a cat's gotta eat.

g_idle_18.text: Hello? Food? Where are you hiding?

g_idle_19.text: I could chase my tail. But then I'd have to catch it.

g_idle_20.text: Cat biscuits. The saddest two words.

g_idle_21.text: Is it Monday? It feels like a Monday.

g_idle_22.text: Hmm. Thinking about lasagna. As usual.

g_idle_23.text: Is it dinner time? It always feels like dinner time.

g_idle_24.text: I could take a nap. Or I could take a nap. Tough choice.

g_idle_25.text: Mondays. Even the word sounds like a hairball.

g_idle_26.text: I'm not fat. I'm just extra huggable.

g_idle_27.text: Exercise. Never heard of it. Sounds made up.

g_idle_28.text: I love lasagna more than I love sleeping. And I really love sleeping.

g_idle_29.text: Hello? Player? I'm not getting any thinner standing here.

g_idle_30.text: My belly is rumbling. It's singing a song called 'feed me'.

g_idle_31.text: Some cats chase mice. I chase snacks. Slowly.

g_idle_32.text: I'd go for a walk, but my legs are on a break.

g_idle_33.text: Nap first, plan later. That's my motto. Well, one of them.

g_idle_34.text: A balanced diet is a lasagna in each paw.

g_idle_35.text: If Mondays were food, they'd be diet biscuits.

g_idle_36.text: I see food, I eat it. It's a very simple system.

g_idle_37.text: Is this floor heated? It should be heated. I'll file a complaint.

g_idle_38.text: I'm just resting my eyes. With my eyes open.

g_idle_39.text: Somewhere out there is a lasagna with my name on it.

g_idle_40.text: I'm not ignoring you. I'm conserving charm.

g_idle_41.text: Hmm. Is that a crumb? No. Just a dust bunny. Tragic.

g_idle_42.text: Stretching counts as exercise. I just did a stretch. Workout over.

g_idle_43.text: Some call it a weight problem. I call it more of me to love.

g_idle_44.text: Thinking about food is my hobby. Eating it is my career.

g_idle_45.text: Cats have nine lives. I plan to spend all nine on the sofa.

g_idle_46.text: Tick tock. The food isn't going to steal itself.

g_idle_47.text: Do I hear a can opener? No. Just my imagination. Again.

g_idle_48.text: If you need me, I'll be here. Being adorable.

g_intro_2.text: Ah, the cul-de-sac. Quiet. Peaceful. Home to the world's most magnificent cat.

g_intro_4.text: Somewhere in there, dinner is happening without me. Unacceptable.

g_jon_down_1.text: Look at him, all stunned. Perfect time for a snack.

g_jon_down_2.text: He's busy. Dinner, here I come.

g_jon_down_3.text: While he's distracted, dinner is undefended.

g_jumpfail_4.text: Too much cat, not enough jump.

g_jumpfail_5.text: Nobody saw that. Nobody saw that.

g_jumpfail_6.text: Maybe I need a run-up. Or a ladder. Or a butler.

g_l02_frontleg.text: Wrong leg. The back ones hold up the Jon.

g_l02_frontleg_nn.text: Wrong leg. The back ones hold up the human.

g_l05_miss.text: Too early. Or too late. Timing is hard.

g_l09_early.text: Not loose enough yet. More belly power needed.

g_l09_ready.text: Table: loosened. Now for the chair.

g_l10_end.text: Chapter complete. Belly complete. Nap... beginning.

g_l10_fridge.text: A fridge is just a lunchbox with a door. And I have paws.

g_l10_open.text: Hello, beautiful. Did you miss me?

g_near_1.text: So close I can taste it. Because I'm about to.

g_near_3.text: There it is. The love of my life. On a plate.

g_near_4.text: Steady. Steady. Don't drool on the table.

g_near_5.text: Hello, dinner. Did you miss me?

g_near_6.text: Mmm. Smells like victory. And gravy.

g_near_steak.text: Steak? Don't mind if I do.

g_open_plan_1.text: Change of plan. I'm having whatever he's having.

g_open_plan_lasagna.text: Lasagna. My true love. My destiny.
g_open_plan_lasagna.gen_text: Lasagna. My true love. My destiny.

g_open_plan_steak.text: Steak, peas and mash. Well, the steak and mash, anyway.
g_open_plan_steak.gen_text: Steak, peas and mash. Well, the steak and mash, anyway.

g_open_spit_2.text: These taste like a cardboard box had a sad day.
g_open_spit_2.gen_text: These taste like a cardboard box had a sad day.

g_open_spit_3.text: Healthy. Ugh. My least favourite flavour.
g_open_spit_3.gen_text: Healthy. Ugh. My least favourite flavour.

g_open_spit_4.text: Nope. My tongue has filed a complaint.
g_open_spit_4.gen_text: Nope. My tongue has filed a complaint.

g_open_spit_5.text: Bleh! That tastes like a sock that gave up on life.

g_open_spit_6.text: That's not food. That's gravel with a marketing team.

g_open_spit_7.text: Ptoo! I can taste the disappointment.

g_paper_hit_2.text: That was a strongly worded newspaper.

g_paper_hit_3.text: Hit by the comics section. Ironic.

g_paper_hit_4.text: Bonk. Headline news: cat hit by headline news.

g_scratch_hit_4.text: Oops. My paw slipped. On purpose.

g_scratch_hit_5.text: Ooh, he's hopping. Like a very sad kangaroo.

g_scratch_hit_6.text: Claws: sharp. Aim: perfect. Guilt: none.

g_scratch_miss_4.text: Swish. That was a warning shot.

g_tut_1.text: Okay. Sneaking lesson. It's like napping, but with walking.

g_tut_2.text: Jon's wandering around. Let's practise on him.

g_tut_2_nn.text: My human's wandering around. Let's practise on him.

g_tut_3.text: He's sitting down to eat. Showtime.

g_tut_camera.text: Drag to look around. Admire the house. It's mine, really. The human just pays for it.

g_tut_chase.text: If he chases me, I climb up high. He can't jump. He can barely walk.

g_tut_done.text: Lesson over. You're a natural. Almost as natural as me.

g_tut_interact.text: Standing on the food? Press the button to eat it. That's the best button.

g_tut_jump.text: Jump! Yes, I can jump. I simply choose not to, most days.

g_tut_jump_up.text: Hop up onto things. The higher I am, the further I am from trouble.

g_tut_move.text: Walk around. Slowly. Majestically. Use the keys, or the stick in the corner.

g_tut_newspaper.text: Watch out for flying newspapers. His aim is terrible, but even he gets lucky.

g_tut_scratch.text: Claws out. Give it a swipe. Scratching is a cat's way of saying hello.

g_tut_wait.text: He'll sit down to eat soon. Patience. Ugh, I hate patience.

g_vase_1.text: Oops. Gravity did that. I just helped.

g_win_10.text: I'm not saying I'm a genius. But I'm not not saying it.

g_win_11.text: That was a team effort. And by team, I mean me.

g_win_6.text: Now THAT is what I call a heist.

g_win_7.text: Another flawless heist. I'd take a bow, but bending is effort.

g_win_8.text: Delicious. Ten out of ten. Would steal again.

g_win_9.text: And that's how it's done. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a nap scheduled.

g_win_lasagna.text: Layers of pasta, layers of cheese, layers of happiness.

g_win_meatloaf.text: Meatloaf. It's a loaf. Made of meat. Genius.

g_win_steak.text: Steak, mash and peas. I even ate the peas. Don't tell anyone.

g_window_1.text: Brrr. Cold air in. Human out. Hopefully.

j_back_1.text: Now, where was I? Oh right. Dinner.
j_back_1.gen_text: Now, where was I? Oh right. Dinner.

j_bed_see.text: My BED! My comfy, cosy bed!

j_bed_see2.text: My quilt! It's more holes than quilt!

j_butt_3.text: Not the pants! These are my good pants!
j_butt_3.gen_text: Not the pants! These are my good pants!

j_chair_floor_2.text: Chair's broken. Back's sore. Pride is definitely broken.

j_chase_10.text: Huff... puff... I should really exercise more.

j_chase_11.text: Whoa! Watch the lamp! Watch the lamp!

j_chase_12.text: Get back here, you furry orange menace!

j_chase_4.text: I just want to talk! With a newspaper!
j_chase_4.gen_text: I just want to talk! With a newspaper!

j_chase_7.text: That's it! You're in big trouble, mister!

j_chase_8.text: How is something so round so fast?

j_chase_9.text: Stop! Stop in the name of dinner!

j_cold_1.text: Brrr! Why is it suddenly freezing?!

j_cold_4.text: It's freezing! I'd better shut that window.

j_curtain_fix.text: Maybe if I hold this bit up… nope.

j_curtain_see.text: My CURTAINS! They were on sale!

j_curtain_see2.text: They're shredded! These were nearly new!

j_eat_5.text: I should cook this more often.

j_eat_6.text: Don't even think about it, buddy.

j_eat_7.text: Mmm, compliments to the chef. That's me!

j_face_2.text: Not the face! Anything but the face!
j_face_2.gen_text: Not the face! Anything but the face!

j_face_3.text: I can't see! …Okay, I can see.
j_face_3.gen_text: I can't see! …Okay, I can see.

j_face_5.text: Not the nose! I need that for smelling dinner!

j_faceplant_2.text: I'm just gonna lie here for a while.

j_giveup_5.text: I'm not climbing on the furniture. I have dignity.

j_giveup_6.text: Huff... you win this round. This round!

j_glare_3.text: No fair! I can't jump that high!
j_glare_3.gen_text: No fair! I can't jump that high!

j_glare_5.text: You have to come down sometime.

j_intro_1.text: Ahh. A quiet evening, a perfect steak, and absolutely no interruptions.
j_intro_1.gen_text: Ahh. A quiet evening, a perfect steak, and absolutely no interruptions.

j_l10_1.text: You won't let me eat my food; I won't let you eat my food. Fine, I just won't eat.
j_l10_1.gen_text: You won't let me eat my food; I won't let you eat my food. Fine, I just won't eat.

j_l10_2.text: There. Safe and sound. Nobody's eating tonight.
j_l10_2.gen_text: There. Safe and sound. Nobody's eating tonight.

j_l10_sulk_1.text: I'm fine. Totally fine. Not hungry at all.
j_l10_sulk_1.gen_text: I'm fine. Totally fine. Not hungry at all.

j_l10_sulk_2.text: My tummy is rumbling. I'm ignoring it.
j_l10_sulk_2.gen_text: My tummy is rumbling. I'm ignoring it.

j_l10_sulk_3.text: This is a very nice chair. I love sitting here. Not eating.
j_l10_sulk_3.gen_text: This is a very nice chair. I love sitting here. Not eating.

j_l10_sulk_4.text: Lalala. Not thinking about lasagna. Not thinking about it at all.

j_leg_2.text: Yeowch! That was my good leg!
j_leg_2.gen_text: Yeowch! That was my good leg!

j_leg_4.text: Ooh! Ah! Ee! Not the shin!

j_leg_5.text: Ow-ow-ow! Why is it always the leg?

j_lost_2.text: Why does this always happen to me?
j_lost_2.gen_text: Why does this always happen to me?

j_lost_3.text: I guess it's cereal for dinner. Again.
j_lost_3.gen_text: I guess it's cereal for dinner. Again.

j_lost_4.text: My plate is empty. Again. Why is my plate always empty?

j_open_bowl_1.text: Here you go, buddy! Crunchy cat biscuits, your favourite!
j_open_bowl_1.gen_text: Here you go, buddy! Crunchy cat biscuits, your favourite!

j_open_bowl_2.text: Dinner is served! One bowl of healthy, nutritious biscuits!
j_open_bowl_2.gen_text: Dinner is served! One bowl of healthy, nutritious biscuits!

j_open_bowl_3.text: Biscuits for you, and something special for me!
j_open_bowl_3.gen_text: Biscuits for you, and something special for me!

j_open_bowl_4.text: Biscuits are served! Crunchy, nutritious, and only a little bit like cardboard.

j_open_bowl_5.text: The vet says these are very good for you, buddy. Very, very good.

j_open_lasagna.text: And for me: a big slice of lasagna, fresh from the pan!
j_open_lasagna.gen_text: And for me: a big slice of lasagna, fresh from the pan!

j_open_lasagna_2.text: Lasagna! Just one scoop for me. Okay, maybe two.

j_open_meatloaf.text: And for me: meatloaf. Plain, simple, honest meatloaf.
j_open_meatloaf.gen_text: And for me: meatloaf. Plain, simple, honest meatloaf.

j_open_meatloaf_2.text: Ah, my famous meatloaf. Nobody makes a loaf of meat quite like me.

j_open_steak.text: And for me: steak, peas and mashed potatoes!
j_open_steak.gen_text: And for me: steak, peas and mashed potatoes!

j_open_steak_2.text: Steak night! With peas! And a mountain of mash! Best night of the week.

j_paper_fetch_1.text: Now where did my paper go…
j_paper_fetch_1.gen_text: Now where did my paper go…

j_paper_fetch_2.text: I hadn't even read the comics yet.
j_paper_fetch_2.gen_text: I hadn't even read the comics yet.

j_stunned.text: Wobble… wobble… is the room spinning?

j_stunned_2.text: Who turned the house into a bouncy castle?

j_stunned_3.text: Ooh... I see little lasagnas spinning round my head.

j_trapped_4.text: Locked in my own bedroom. This is a new low.

j_trapped_5.text: I hope nobody's eating my dinner out there!

j_vase_see.text: My good vase! In a million pieces!

j_vase_see3.text: My vase! Who did this? ...Don't answer that.

j_vase_spare.text: Good thing I keep a spare vase.

j_vase_spare2.text: Second spare vase. I buy them in bulk.

j_vase_sweep.text: Where did I put that broom…

j_wander_1.text: La la la, dinner time soon!

j_wander_10.text: I wonder if I should take up the tuba again.

j_wander_11.text: Did I leave the oven on? No. Probably. No.

j_wander_12.text: Maybe I'll organise my sock drawer tonight. Wild night!

j_wander_13.text: Ooh, I could alphabetise the spice rack!

j_wander_14.text: Doo doo doo... walking, walking, walking...

j_wander_15.text: Why do I feel like I'm being watched?

j_wander_16.text: That cat is up to something. I can feel it.

j_wander_17.text: I should call my mum. After dinner. Definitely after dinner.

j_wander_18.text: Mmm, I can smell dinner from here.

j_wander_19.text: La la la, nobody's going to steal my dinner tonight...

j_wander_2.text: Where did I put my glasses? …Oh, they're on my face.
j_wander_2.gen_text: Where did I put my glasses? …Oh, they're on my face.

j_wander_20.text: I wonder what the dog next door is doing.

j_wander_21.text: Diet biscuits. Healthy cat. Happy me. That's the plan.

j_wander_5.text: Note to self: hide the lasagna better.

j_wander_6.text: I wonder if the TV has anything good on.

j_wander_7.text: Who left cat hair on the sofa? …Oh. Right.

j_wander_8.text: Hmm hmm hmm, la la la...

l01_hint_1.text: Jon's face is up high. I need to be up high too.

l01_hint_1_nn.text: His face is up high. I need to be up high too.

l01_hint_2.text: If I jump on the table next to him, I can reach his face.

l02_hint_2.text: If a back leg of Jon's chair broke… timber!

l02_hint_2_nn.text: If a back leg of his chair broke... timber!

l02_hint_3.text: Scratch the BACK leg of Jon's chair.

l02_hint_3_nn.text: Scratch the BACK leg of his chair.

l03_hint_1.text: That vase on the windowsill looks… breakable.

l03_hint_2.text: Jump on the windowsill and give that vase a little nudge.

l03_hint_3.text: Scratch the vase off the sill, then run for the food while Jon looks.

l03_hint_3_nn.text: Scratch the vase off the sill, then run for the food while he looks.

l04_hint_2.text: If I really shred those curtains, Jon will have to come and look.

l04_hint_2_nn.text: If I really shred those curtains, he'll have to come and look.

l04_hint_3.text: Scratch the curtains a few times. Then eat while he's busy.

l05_hint_1.text: The fridge top looks like a good view. How do I get up there?

l05_hint_2.text: Chair, counter, bread bin, fridge. Step by step.

l05_hint_3.text: Grab the vine on the fridge, swing over the table and press Space over the pan!

l06_hint_1.text: He's guarding that plate like a dragon.

l06_hint_2.text: What if the food… fell off the table?

l06_hint_3.text: Jump on the table and scratch the plate! Then eat it off the floor.

l07_hint_1.text: It's a bit stuffy in here. Some fresh air would be nice.

l07_hint_2.text: If I open that window, Jon will have to close it.

l07_hint_2_nn.text: If I open that window, he'll have to close it.

l07_hint_3.text: Jump on the windowsill, press Space to open the window, then go eat.

l08_hint_1.text: Jon loves his bed. Almost as much as I love his dinner.

l08_hint_1_nn.text: He loves his bed. Almost as much as I love his dinner.

l08_hint_2.text: If I scratch up his bed, he'll come running upstairs…

l08_hint_3.text: Shred the bed, wait for Jon to go in, then close the door on him!

l08_hint_3_nn.text: Shred the bed, wait for him to go in, then close the door on him!

l09_hint_1.text: This table is wobbly. And I am… substantial.

l09_hint_2.text: If I jump under the table enough, things will start shaking.

l09_hint_3.text: Bump the table 3 times from below, then walk under Jon's chair!

l09_hint_3_nn.text: Bump the table three times from below, then walk under his chair!

l10_hint_1.text: That vase is back. Jon never learns.

l10_hint_1_nn.text: That vase is back. He never learns.

l10_hint_2.text: If Jon's busy by the broken vase… a little scratch might trip him up.

l10_hint_2_nn.text: If he's busy by the broken vase... a little scratch might trip him up.

l10_hint_3.text: Knock the vase off, scratch Jon next to the pieces, then raid the fridge!

l10_hint_3_nn.text: Knock the vase off, scratch him next to the pieces, then raid the fridge!
